issue.body:
## REST Compatible API v7 completeness

As described in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/51816 all breaking changes could be subject to applying some compatibility at the REST layer to assist with upgrades. This issue exists to ensure that there is a complete and exhaustive list of all breaking changes and make the determination REST API compatibility should be applied. 

A complete list of all breaking changes categorized by 
* Requires REST API compatibility with v7
* Does not require REST API compatibility with v7
* Unsure - needs more investigation (temporary status while we work through the list)
* Potentially leverage REST API compatibility, but out of immediate scope

The number of check boxes here should equal number of closed issues from this query: 
[Eldest to newest breaking changes](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues?q=label%3Av8.0.0+label%3A%3Ebreaking+is%3Aclosed+sort%3Acreated-asc)

Each line item should have a independent validation, and line items that require changes should be linked to the associated PR and issues. For specific compatibilities that require discussions, please open a new issue (as opposed to the comments of this issue).

## Requires REST API compatibility with v7

#### Misc 
//TODO: break up into better categories

- [ ] Remove deprecated _time and _term sort orders https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/39450 - //Przemek: this parses directly using XContentParser (not using ObjectParser and field declaration). Should be a fairly easy to do with surgical conditional (if parser.getRestVersion=V7)
- [ ] Parse empty first line in msearch request body as action metadata https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41011 //Przemek: a request shape change. A fairly minor, but would be breaking users. The compatible change is basicallly bringing back the 7.x code (deprecation and parsing) and wrapping with if(isCompatible). The readMultiLineFormat would have to get that flag from restrequest in RestMultiSearchAction
- [ ] Get snapshots support for multiple repositories  https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/42090 //Przemek: it is a fairly big change and might require help from es-distributed team. There is an issue for this work already https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/69108
- [ ] Remove CommonTermsQuery and cutoff_frequency param  https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/42654 //Przemek: it looks like a fairly simple change. For `cutoff_frequency` we could simply allow to parse these but do nothing. **But for `CommonTermsQuery` it looks more complex** and I am not sure how to implement this without bringing too much code back.
- [ ] Remove deprecated sort options: nested_path and nested_filter https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/42809 
- [x] Reindex remove outer level size https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/43373 compatible reindex https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/69037 compatible update/delete by query https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/69606
- [ ] [ML][Data Frame] removing format support in date_histogram group_by  https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/43659 (feature was beta when this change was made)
- [ ] Force Merge should reject requests with `only_expunge_deletes` and `max_num_segments` set  https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/44761 
- [ ] Remove deprecated endpoints containing _xpack. https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/48170 
- [ ] Remove the 'template' field in index templates https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/49460 
- [ ] Remove the 'local' parameter of /_cat/nodes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/50594
- [ ] Goodbye and thank you synced flush! https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/50882 
- [ ] Remove support for settings in restore requests https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/53284 
- [ ] Remove the object format for indices_boost https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/55078 
- [ ] Remove local parameter for get field mapping request https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/55100 
- [ ] Remove use_field_mapping format option for docvalue fields https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/55622 
- [ ] Remove node filters for voting config exclusions https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/55673 
- [ ] Scripting: Move script_cache into _nodes/stats https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/59265 
- [ ] Consolidate script parsing from object https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/59507 
- [ ] [ML] Remove deprecated _xpack endpoints #59870
- [ ] Rename binary_soft_classification evaluation to outlier_detection https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/59951  (feature was experimental when this change was made)
- [ ] Remove deprecated _upgrade API https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/64732 
- [ ] Remove the deprecated local parameter for _cat/shards https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/64867 
- [ ] Remove the deprecated local parameter for _cat/indices https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/64868
- [ ] [Transform] use ISO dates in output instead of epoch millis https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/65584 
- [ ] Returning nested data in fields API  https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/67432 
- [ ] Remove MovingAverage pipeline aggregation  https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/39328

#### Types

These are mostly managed by https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/54160. The issues here match 1:1 to the issues with `>breaking` label to help ensure the counts of breaking changes and number of checkboxes are equal.

-  _Removes typed URLs https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41636_ not merged. splitted into multiple prs

- [ ] Removes tpyed endpoints for msearch and mtermvector APIs https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41674
- [ ] Removes typed URLs from mapping APIs https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/41676 
- [ ] Removes types from bulk API https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/42194

- [ ] Remove `include_type_name` parameter from REST layer https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/48632

#### Mappings
- [ ] Remove support for chained multi-fields.  https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/42333
- [ ] Remove support for string in unmapped_type https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/45675

- [ ] Fix updating include_in_parent/include_in_root of nested field https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/54386 
- [ ] Disallow changing 'enabled' on the root mapper https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/54463 
- [ ] Add declarative parameters to FieldMappers https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/58663 (needs a better look)


## Unsure - needs more investigation

- [ ] [ML] add new flag `exclude_generated` that removes generated fields in GET config APIs https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/63899 
- [ ] Don't expose TextFieldMapper subfields https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/64597 
- [ ] QL: "fields" api implementation in QL https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/68802 

## Potentially leverage REST API compatibility, but out of immediate scope

#### scripting

- [ ] Update the signature of vector script functions https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/48260 
- [ ] Remove deprecated vector functions  https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/48725

#### EQL

- [ ] EQL: Forbid usage of ['] for string literals https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/62458 
- [ ] EQL: Replace ?"..." with """...""" for unescaped strings https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/62539 
- [ ] EQL: Replace [`] with ['] for identifiers https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/62638 
- [ ] EQL: Remove support for `=` for comparisons https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/62756 

## Does not require REST API compatibility with v7
#### Setttings

Settings are not subject to REST API compatibility. Often the changes behind the settings represent some behavior that is not carried forward. 

- [x] Remove obsolete security settings  https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/40496

#### Validation

Additional or stricter validation is a type of breaking change that can change the response of a request from a success to a specific failure. However, success -> error responses are not covered by REST API compatibility and is considered behavior.

body:
so for v7 response:
 if someone is using the regular `/_snapshot/{repository}/{snapshot}` with repository being exact name (not all, or * or multiple values) I could just iterate over successfulResponses and generate a response

if the failedResponse was not empty, then I would return the exception - I would not even iterate the successfulResponses.
Should I just take first failure from `failedResponse`? previously in 7 we would not expect a list of exceptions, but only one.

I don't expect for singleRepo, singleSnapshot api to return mix of successful and failed response in v7. Is this assumption ok?

now if someone would try to use `/_snapshot/all/all` with v7 api, then it would get tricky. I have a feeling that this is unlikely as folks would not have their apps/clients updated to do this.
For simplicity I thought I could just iterate all successfulResponses and merge them all together (skip the repository json level)
However failedResponse was not empty, then for the reason mentioned above, I would not bother iterating successfulResponses. 

What do you think?

@pgomulka sorry for not spotting this earlier! I'm actually working on exactly this issue in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/74451 right now which will make v8 mostly use the v7 format again for requests that v7 APIs can respond to. Would you be ok with me assigning this to myself?

We discussed this with Armin and there is a chance that there possibly won't be a breaking change for the get snapshots.
You can ignore my [comments](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/69108#issuecomment-866642488)

issue.body:
This PR returns the get snapshots API to the 7.x format (and transport client behavior) and enhances it for requests that ask for multiple repositories.
The changes for requests that target multiple repositories are:
* Add `repository` field to `SnapshotInfo` and REST response
* Add `failures` map alongside `snapshots` list instead of returning just an exception response as done for single repo requests
* Pagination now works across repositories instead of being per repository for multi-repository requests

closes #69108
closes #43462
